title: Polynomial bound on reduction length
statement: For every finite nondeterministic Turing machine over the Boolean alphabet and every natural number $c_0$, there are natural numbers $C,c$ such that, for every input bit string $x$, the reduction output has length at most $C(|x|+1)^c$.
hypotheses_covered: a finite nondeterministic Turing machine over the Boolean alphabet
